meta.title: fix: compress images in style panel and set default fill mode to Fill
meta.body_summary: Add image compression before insertion in ImageManager and change default backgroundSize from empty string to 'cover' for better initial image display.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added image compression and changed default fill to cover; maintainer reverted cover default before merging after bot review suggestions.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 913 changed lines across 9 files, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume, though most churn is in bun.lock (756 lines) from dependency updates in merge commits. The core change is only ~19 lines of logic. This aligns with a small-step performance fix that merged after one maintainer correction.

review_details.concern_detail: Bot flagged silent compression failure as potential UI inconsistency; maintainer removed the default 'cover' backgroundSize, reverting that part of the agent's change.
review_details.performance_claim: Image compression reduces file size before insertion, aiming to improve loading performance and reduce memory usage.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin successfully added image compression but also changed a default UI setting (backgroundSize to 'cover') that the maintainer disagreed with and reverted. This shows the agent can implement performance features but may overstep by modifying defaults without clear requirement.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer reviewed the default fill mode change and removed it, preferring no default or the original empty string.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance metrics provided; change is functional only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer Kitenite committed 'Remove default cover' to revert the backgroundSize default before merging.

core_change_summary.description: Added image compression in ImageManager by fetching base64 image, converting to File, using existing compressImage utility, and logging errors on failure. Changed backgroundSize default from empty string to 'cover' in style groups, later reverted by maintainer.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line churn comes from merge-of-main commits updating bun.lock (756 lines) and other dependency/config files.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: add image compression and set default backgroundSize to 'cover'.
Maintainer commit: remove default cover setting.
Merge from main branch to sync dependencies.

review_signals.summary: Silent compression failure could lead to UI inconsistency; suggested user-facing error message or fallback.
Suggested setting backgroundPosition default to 'center' to match backgroundSize pattern.
Bot summarized PR changes with no blocking comments.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with compression and default cover.
Greptile bot posted non-blocking review comments on silent failure and style.
Maintainer Kitenite made commit 'Remove default cover' to revert the default.
